domain: Finite algebraic constructor values; scalar-valid runtime Unicode strings; U32 keys; globally unique binder IDs in the substitution fragment. Constructor-display controls include ASCII decimal spellings of invalid scalar candidates (for example $ctor.55296_), whose rejection must preserve the original string. No actual invalid Char constructors, missing JS fields, cycles, malformed App arities, unsafe continuation reuse, or whole-program correctness claim.
oracle: reference.py uses positional data specifications, mathematical sets, first/last occurrence selection, Unicode scalar encoding, and capture-free beta semantics. It never imports production code. Full expected values and all inputs are frozen per run.
